I pieced together the layers from the final output. I did it by hand to avoid writing code. I saved it and picking it up here.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

setwd(here::here('output','report files'))
df <- read.csv("report_i_made_from_risk_at_port_summary_layers.csv")
df$total_risk <- as.numeric(df$total_risk)
View(df  |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count) |>  group_by(scenario, Container, PoE, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> ungroup() |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk))


View(df |> group_by(scenario, PoE, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count, -Container) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk))

View(df |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count, -Container, -PoE) |> group_by(scenario, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk))
```
